from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import Bin, MultiCut

# Jet multiplicity binning (exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6 jets)
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="njets",
    cuts=[
        Bin("4j", lambda events: events.JetGood.pt.count() == 4),
        Bin("5j", lambda events: events.JetGood.pt.count() == 5),
        Bin("6j+", lambda events: events.JetGood.pt.count() >= 6),
    ]
)

# B-tag multiplicity binning (exactly 2, at least 3 b-jets)
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="nbtags",
    cuts=[
        Bin("2b", lambda events: (events.JetGood.btagDeepB > 0.2712).sum() == 2),
        Bin("3b+", lambda events: (events.JetGood.btagDeepB > 0.2712).sum() >= 3),
    ]
)

# Cartesian product of the two binnings
analysis_categories = jet_multiplicity & btag_multiplicity
